description: Execute one supported deterministic query, compute immutable manifest hashes, persist the manifest and the result, and optionally return the result payload. Supported query types are financial_state_time_series, metric_time_series, metric_bundle_time_series and financials_as_of; financials_as_of is the as-of financials read and requires as_of_date. Parameters the query type does not take are ignored and not stored. The same query over the same data always yields the same replay_token, and each organization receives a manifest of its own: running a query again returns your organization's first manifest for it, with its created_at.

as_of_date.description: Optional no-lookahead boundary date applied by supported query types.

include_result.description: Whether to include the executed result payload in the response body.

parameters.description: Query parameters for the selected query type. Keys the query type does not take are ignored and not stored.

query_type.description: Supported deterministic query type: 'financial_state_time_series', 'metric_time_series', 'metric_bundle_time_series', 'financials_as_of' or 'financials_as_of_page'. 'financials_as_of' takes cik, and optionally audit_mode, and requires as_of_date. 'financials_as_of_page' is one page of that read, as GET /v1/edgar/as-of/{date}/financials/{cik}/page selects it: it takes cik, and optionally audit_mode, statement_type, fiscal_year_from, fiscal_year_to, fiscal_period, latest_only, offset, limit (1-50, default 20) and as_of_timestamp (a timestamp with an offset, falling on as_of_date), and requires as_of_date.

name: query_execute
title: Execute a deterministic public query
